issuer: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention
title: Lassa Fever Situation Report Epi Week 34: 17th – 23rd August 2026
excerpt: Cumulatively, 253 deaths have been reported with a Case Fatality Rate (CFR) of 24.0% which is higher than the CFR for the same period in 2025 (18.7%). In total for 2026, 24 States have recorded at least one confirmed case across 118 Local Government Areas.

issuer: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention
title: Lassa Fever Situation Report Epi Week 34: 17th – 23rd August 2026 — Recommendations
excerpt: Healthcare Workers- Maintain high suspicion for Lassa fever and initiate timely referral and treatment, and adhere to standard infection prevention and control procedures.

issuer: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention
title: Lassa Fever Situation Report Epi Week 33, 2026
excerpt: In week 33, the number of new confirmed cases increased from 4 reported in epi week 32 of 2026 to 14. These were reported in Ondo, Edo, Bauchi and Benue States. Cumulatively, 252 deaths have been reported with a Case Fatality Rate (CFR) of 24.4%.

issuer: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention
title: Measles Situation Report July 2026
excerpt: In July 2026: Kebbi (54), Kano (40), Ekiti (38), Ondo (24), Akwa-Ibom (23), Osun (17), and Lagos (17) accounted for 64.94% of the 328 suspected cases. A total of 123 LGAs across 27 States reported at least one suspected case.

issuer: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention
title: Diphtheria Situation Report Epi Week 3: 12th January 2026 – 18th January 2026
excerpt: A total of 36 suspected cases were reported from 1 state across 3 LGAs. Of the 36 suspected cases reported, 34 (94.4%) were confirmed cases. Zero (0) deaths (CFR: 0%) were recorded among the confirmed cases.
